{{Youmay|living beings that could not be sensed through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]|a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbances in the Force]], anomalies in the Force that could be sensed by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], or a [[Wound in the Force/Legends|wound in the Force]], a type of disturbance in the Force that distorted and weakened the influence of the will of the Force}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|There are beings that Jedi call ''voids''. At first sight they seem to give off no real energy, rather like a hologram. But only beings with great power can project a simple ''blank'' to a Jedi. Sometimes a void can be much more dangerous than a being who pulses with the dark side of the Force. They are clever and focused enough to hide their dark side, and hide it so well they can even hide it from Jedi for a time.|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi describes a "void" or "blank" in the Force to his 14-year-old Padawan Anakin Skywalker on [[Ragoon VI]].|<ref name=":0" />}}
A '''void''' or '''blank''', was a rare and nearly unheard of phenomenon, in which a living entity seemed to be fully nonexistent in [[The Force/Legends|The Force]]. Such a being could neutralize his appearance and aura so completely that those who met him could not recall what he looked like.<ref name=":0">''[[Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi]]''</ref><ref name="Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap">''[[Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap]]''</ref>

[[File:Nathema.png|thumb|right|200px|Nathema became a void after Vitiate's ritual.]]
The earliest known examples of this event were the castings of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Sith Emperor's ritual|ritual]] that he used to consume life in order to maintain his [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]], both [[Ritual of Nathema|from]] his [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nathema]], and later [[Emperor's ritual crisis|attempted]] from the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. When the Emperor fed, he created a complete "void" in the Force, and took away color and nearly all sound in the area.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], [[Granta Omega]], the son of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xanatos]], was described as a "void" in the Force by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who himself could only speculate Omega was utilizing some form of self-concealment technique.<ref name=":0" /> Peculiarly, Omega's ability allowed him to escape detection by the Jedi, and also rendered him extraordinarily difficult to remember. Even in the event someone did recall him vaguely, they would not be able to describe his appearance in any manner that was exact or precise.

Another incident of this marvel was identified in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], concerning the Human clone assassin [[X-7]]. As noted by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ferus Olin]], X-7 was noted as having a hollowed body, with the Force flowing around him, rather than through him.<ref name="Rebel Force: Trapped">''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''</ref> This was the first and only known incident of such a phenomenon occurring artificially.

Perhaps the most outstanding cases were those of the assassin [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] siblings, [[Nyss Nenn|Nyss]] and [[Syll Nenn]]. Both siblings displayed the ability to create a dark void in the force, making them undetectable to [[Force sense/Legends|Force sense]]. Further still, the Nenn twins could also make the Force inaccessible to [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] (though [[Jaden Korr]] and his clones were powerful enough to overcome this for unknown reasons). Indeed, this power was potent to the degree that they were capable of nullifying the force energy present in some [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]], causing them to shut off completely. After the death of Syll, Nyss Nenn felt that his ability had increased, when while his sister was alive, he had always psychologically thought that she was an amplifier.<ref name="Riptide">[[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']]</ref>

The phenomenon of a Force ''void'' must not be confused with the [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] known as [[Force cloak]]. Whereas the former was an inherent ability found only among beings with natural leanings toward the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], who gravitated or were naturally drawn to it, the latter was a talent or an acquired skill predominantly among practitioners of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]. Both phenomena were very rare.
